breakdown.description: Fanning friction factor is used directly in the Darcy–Weisbach equation without converting to Darcy friction factor.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification states the Fanning friction factor is 0.005 and provides the Darcy–Weisbach equation, but does NOT instruct converting the Fanning friction factor to the Darcy friction factor (f_D = 4 × f_F = 0.02) before using it. This repeats the original error of using the Fanning friction factor directly in the Darcy–Weisbach equation.
